notes: Is update mein Auto RePost ki sab se bari khami theek ki gayi hai: pehle jab koi post fail hoti thi to card par sirf 'Request failed with status code 400' likha aata tha — na wajah, na tafseel. Ab har fail post ke sath saaf likha ayega ke fail kis stage par hui (download, token ya publish) aur Facebook ya YouTube ne asal mein kya jawab diya. Aik aur aham baat: aap ke War Command Files Page par Facebook ki identity verification baqi hai — jab tak aap Facebook app mein apni identity verification mukammal nahi karte (Menu → Settings → Accounts Center → Identity Confirmation), Facebook kisi bhi app ko is Page par video post nahi karne dega. Ab app is surat mein video ko fail nahi karegi: video line mein mehfooz rahegi, us ki koshish zaya nahi hogi, aur card par saaf note ayega ke identity verification baqi hai. Verification mukammal karte hi agli check par video khud post ho jayegi. Download wala hissa aap ke phone par pehle hi saabit ho chuka hai (queue 35 videos tak barh gayi thi aur video download bhi ho gayi thi — rukawat sirf publish par thi).
